title: Strengthen and qualify the release-gate fixture's pre-release assertion
outcome: The release-gate behavioral fixture distinguishes an initially open gate deterministically and describes the limits of its instantaneous worker-completion observation without adding sleeps or timeout waits.
acceptance: The existing behavioral explicit-release scenario also rejects an initially open gate before release; successful release and both worker completions remain checked.

The test's name and explanation do not claim a schedule-independent proof that a worker is parked from pre-wait readiness or one try_recv observation; unwind/poison/original-panic behavior and existing guard limits remain covered without real sleeps or expiry tests.
